status: M5-B comparison complete; model thresholds proposed for user confirmation

pvs.reference: Fossen 2021, Handbook of Marine Craft Hydrodynamics and Motion Control, 2nd ed.; Allen et al. 2000
pvs.implementation: Python class with forward-Euler plant and actuator update

mss.reference: Fossen 2027, Handbook of Marine Craft Hydrodynamics and Motion Control, 3rd ed.; Allen et al. 2000
mss.implementation: Octave/MATLAB state derivative; SIMremus100.m integrates with RK4

source_differences.consequence: About 0.1% difference in hydrodynamic forces; record but do not silently normalize.

source_differences.pvs: a=0.8000 m, b=0.0950 m; derived mass=31.0294 kg despite 31.9 kg in the module docstring
source_differences.consequence: The project VehicleSpec uses 31.0 kg, matching PVS code, not the nominal 31.9 kg value or MSS.

source_differences.mss: 20 deg in the model and SIMremus100.m
source_differences.consequence: A 15 deg controller command saturates PVS but not MSS unless the MSS comparison applies a 15 deg cap.

source_differences.pvs: exponential taper applied to surge and sway damping
source_differences.mss: exponential taper applied to surge damping only
source_differences.consequence: Sway and turning responses can differ even with identical mass and fin commands.

source_differences.pvs: 20-strip Hoerner model; sway force and yaw moment only
source_differences.mss: 20-strip DNV cylinder model; sway, heave, yaw and pitch contributions
source_differences.consequence: Vertical-plane response and combined pitch/yaw maneuvers are not expected to match numerically.

source_differences.pvs: horizontal uniform current only; no vertical component
source_differences.mss: horizontal plus vertical uniform current through w_c
source_differences.consequence: Vertical-current scenarios must use MSS or an explicitly documented reduced model, never PVS silently.

source_differences.pvs: first-order fin lag T_delta=0.1 s and propeller lag T_n=1.0 s
source_differences.mss: plant model accepts actual fin angles directly; SIMremus100.m updates RPM by a discrete 0.1 RPM step and has no fin lag
source_differences.consequence: The MSS runner must apply the same external fin/RPM actuator model before comparing plant states.

source_differences.pvs: forward Euler at the caller sample time; current project uses 0.02 s
source_differences.mss: model returns xdot; SIMremus100.m defaults to RK4 at 0.05 s
source_differences.consequence: Integrator and step size are experiment variables and must be identical or included in a convergence study.

source_differences.pvs: separate eta/nu; NED position, z positive down, Euler angles internally
source_differences.mss: 12-state Euler or 13-state quaternion; NED position, z positive down
source_differences.consequence: The Python adapter must convert xyzw quaternions and preserve the NED z-down convention.

source_differences.pvs: positive rudder gives positive yaw moment; positive stern plane gives negative pitch moment
source_differences.mss: same model-force signs; SIMremus100.m passes -delta_s at its controller boundary
source_differences.consequence: Compare plant inputs delta_r, delta_s directly; do not copy the SIM controller's extra stern-plane negation into the adapter.

source_differences.pvs: beta_c is the NED direction toward which the current flows
source_differences.consequence: The current vector direction is consistent; body components are computed with beta_c - yaw.

project_contract_warnings.source_values: PVS documents 2.5 m/s at 1525 RPM in zero current; MSS SIM range check allows 0-5 m/s
project_contract_warnings.action: Do not use speeds above 2.5 m/s in M5 comparisons until a source and operating point are documented.

project_contract_warnings.source_values: nominal 31.9 kg; PVS derived 31.0294 kg; MSS derived 31.9316 kg
project_contract_warnings.action: Keep native plant parameters for the first comparison, then run a mass/density sensitivity case.

frozen_m5_decisions.native_plant_parameters: Keep PVS and MSS native masses and densities; do not normalize vendor internals.
frozen_m5_decisions.external_actuator_model: Use the PVS first-order fin and RPM lag for both plants.
frozen_m5_decisions.integrator: Use Euler for matched trajectory comparison; report MSS RK4 separately in the step-size convergence study.
comparison_levels: Level N: implementation check with aligned physics toggles and identical state/inputs.
Level M: native PVS versus native MSS to quantify documented model-version differences.

model_differences_not_numerically_reconc: MSS uses a 1.0096-scaled spheroid and therefore a larger derived mass and inertia than PVS.
MSS uses DNV cylinder cross-flow terms in sway, heave, yaw and pitch; PVS uses a Hoerner model with sway and yaw only.
PVS applies high-speed exponential taper to surge and sway damping; MSS applies it only to surge damping.

A pure density increase has no first-order acceleration effect because mass, added mass, weight, buoyancy, drag and thrust all scale with density; the observed differences are not explained by 1025 versus 1026 kg/m3 alone.
